title: Lord of the Harvest, Hear
description: Lord of the Harvest, Hear in Tonic Solfa to SOUTHWELL, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 491.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SOUTHWELL; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Lord of the har-vest, hear Thy nee-dy ser-vants cry; An-swer our faith’s ef-fec-tual prayer And all our wants sup-ply.

lines: Our wants are in Thy view.
The harvest, truly, Lord, is great,
And let them speak Thy Word of Power
Oh, let them spread Thy name,

licence: Public domain: Charles Wesley died in 1788.
credits: Words by Charles Wesley (1707–1788), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to SOUTHWELL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
